## About
Musher Auto Body is a family owned and operated collision repair shop in Cicero, serving the Near West Side of Chicago and nearby towns like Berwyn, Oak Park, Forest Park and La Grange.
We know how upsetting it is to need collision repair. So we give up front pricing, and our technicians explain the repair process until it makes sense to you. We help customers in English and Spanish.
The owner, Alberto, is at the shop. If you have a dent, a scratch or something bigger, stop by or give us a call.

## Services
- Collision repair: Minor accident touch ups through major collision repair, with a fair quote and a reasonable estimate of repair time.
- Dent, fender and unibody repair: Most types of auto body work, including dents, door dings, fenders and unibody repair.
- Frame and unibody repair: Frame work for vehicles with structural damage.
- Paint and paint matching: Expert paint matching so the repaired area blends with the rest of your car.
- Scratches: One customer had scratches removed here and said it was done at an affordable price.
- Suspension details: Suspension work that comes with collision damage.

## FAQ
Q: How do I get a body work quote?
A: Call the shop or send your details and questions through the contact form. Please allow 24 to 48 hours for a reply to the form.

Q: Do you work with insurance companies?
A: One customer said the shop worked well with her insurance company after her accidents.

Q: Can I get help in Spanish?
A: Yes. Service is offered in both English and Spanish.
